methodology: JFR profile settings; first recognized subsystem from leaf; sample counts are not exact CPU time; allocation weights are estimates
durationCaveat: Monitor/park and compilation durations sum across threads and may exceed wall time; park stacks containing ExactCache include nested terrain waits, not solely follower waits. Events below recording thresholds are absent. GC sums use GarbageCollection.sumOfPauses, not overlapping phase events.
